author: smeriano
body:
This PR extends the phase-2 tau validation workflow with new decay-mode and fake-sources plots for both HLT and RECO taus.

The decay-mode histograms are stored in a dedicated `DecayModes` DQM folder. A helper script is also added to produce comparison and summary plots for the different decay modes. 

Tagging @elenavernazza
title: Adding Decay Modes and Fake Sources for the Tau Phase 2 Validation tool
